result.summary: Found 3 visual issues: unreadable promo banner text due to white-on-light-green low contrast, inconsistent wishlist heart button styling on popular cards, and truncated restaurant title in the horizontal carousel.

issues.description: Promotional banner text '3 free deliveries for you' and 'Use code TALLINN3 at checkout...' is white on a very pale mint-green background with extremely low contrast and is barely readable.
issues.suggestion: Change banner text to a dark color (e.g., dark green or black) on the light background to meet WCAG AA contrast requirements

issues.description: Favorite heart icon on Tokumaru Ramen Bar card has no background container and floats directly on image, while the pizza card below shows a dark circular background behind the heart. Styling is inconsistent and first icon has poor visibility.
issues.suggestion: Apply the same dark semi-transparent circular background container to all favorite icons for consistency, contrast and clear tap target

issues.description: Third card in 'Fastest near you' shows truncated restaurant name as 'Trattoria Piccol' cut off at viewport edge without ellipsis.
issues.suggestion: Ensure truncated titles use ellipsis and add end padding to horizontal carousel so card content is not abruptly clipped
